```{r}

# here::here sets the wd to be Xenium/R so I need to go up a level to get to dat

pathA <- here("../data/raw/Blocks A and B/20260731__175152__SR26-0828_Lund_XeniumV2_2607/output-XETG00440__0103580__JL3_A__20260731__175201")

# Rachel's here() starts at /mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon

full_path <- "/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/raw/Blocks A and B/20260731__175152__SR26-0828_Lund_XeniumV2_2607/output-XETG00440__0103580__JL3_A__20260731__175201"

# Load the Xenium data
xenium.obj <- LoadXenium(full_path, fov = "fov", segmentations = "cell")

# remove cells with 0 counts
xenium.obj <- subset(xenium.obj, subset = nCount_Xenium > 0)
```


```{r}
# we detected around 50 genes and around 5 copies of each gene per cell 

VlnPlot(xenium.obj, features = c("nFeature_Xenium", "nCount_Xenium"), ncol = 2, pt.size = 0)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "vln_nfeature_ncount.png"))

ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, fov = "fov", molecules = c("ISG15", "KRT18", "ESR2", "EGR"), nmols = 1000)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_image_dimplot.png"))
```


```{r image feature plot}
ImageFeaturePlot(xenium.obj, features = c("KRT18", "PGR"), max.cutoff='q90', size = 0.75, cols = c("white", "red"), axes = T)

# max.cutoff='q90' useful to make it look nice
```

```{r zoom in - crop function}
cropped.coords <- Crop(xenium.obj[["fov"]], x = c(8000, 12000), y = c(1000, 4000), coords = "plot")

# *** x and y are swapped ?? 

xenium.obj[["zoom"]] <- cropped.coords

# visualize cropped area with cell segmentations & selected molecules
DefaultBoundary(xenium.obj[["zoom"]]) <- "segmentation"
ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, fov = "zoom", axes = TRUE, border.color = "white", border.size = 0.1, cols = "polychrome",
    coord.fixed = FALSE, molecules = c("KRT18", "PGR", "ESR2"), nmols = 10000)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_zoomed_image_dimplot.png"))

# try zooming in more to see the boundaries better
cropped.coords <- Crop(xenium.obj[["fov"]], x = c(10000, 11000), y = c(1000, 2000), coords = "plot")

## don't use an underscore in this name
xenium.obj[["morezoom"]] <- cropped.coords

DefaultBoundary(xenium.obj[["morezoom"]]) <- "segmentation"
ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, fov = "morezoom", axes = TRUE, border.color = "white", border.size = 0.1, cols = "polychrome",
    coord.fixed = FALSE, molecules = c("KRT18", "PGR", "ESR2"), nmols = 1000)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_zoomed_image_dimplot.png"))
```
```{r}
xenium.obj <- SCTransform(xenium.obj, assay = "Xenium")
xenium.obj <- RunPCA(xenium.obj, npcs = 30, features = rownames(xenium.obj))
xenium.obj <- RunUMAP(xenium.obj, dims = 1:30)
xenium.obj <- FindNeighbors(xenium.obj, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
xenium.obj <- FindClusters(xenium.obj, resolution = 0.3)

# make a umap
DimPlot(xenium.obj, cols = "polychrome")
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_xenium_umap.png"))

ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, cols = "polychrome", size = 0.75)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_xenium_image_umap.png"))
```

```{r}
xenium.obj <- BuildNicheAssay(object = xenium.obj, fov = "fov", group.by = "seurat_clusters",
    niches.k = 5, neighbors.k = 30)
# did not work for "morezoom" fov
# error message: Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)) : 
#  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function #'as.matrix': non-conformable arguments

celltype.plot <- ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, group.by = "seurat_clusters", size = 1.5, cols = "polychrome",
    dark.background = F) + ggtitle("Cell type")
niche.plot <- ImageDimPlot(xenium.obj, group.by = "niches", size = 1.5, dark.background = F) + ggtitle("Niches") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#442288", "#6CA2EA", "#B5D33D", "#FED23F", "#EB7D5B"))
celltype.plot | niche.plot
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "our_first_niche_plot.png"))

table(xenium.obj$seurat_clusters, xenium.obj$niches)
```
